title: Flagship W-MATCMP investigation, non-AI leg

scope.schedule: 2 y irradiation + cooling at 0, 1 d, 1 y, 100 y, 1000 y
scope.robustness: 24 samples per case; composition_rel_std 0.3 on Ag/Co/Cu/Mo/Nb/Ni, flux_rel_std 0.05; cross_section_mf33 channel not enabled for this study

headline_results.dominant_finding: At 100 y the high-vs-low activity difference is driven by Ni-63 (96.4% of +28.4 Bq/g), produced via Ni-64(n,gamma); Ni is the controlling impurity in this scenario, not Nb. Nb-94 pathways attribute to Mo-98 feed, not the Nb impurity.
headline_results.early_time_reversal: At shutdown/1d/1y the ordering is flat to reversed (<1% spread, bulk-nuclide dominated); the declared ranking applies only at the scoped 100 y cooling time.
headline_results.robustness_survival: Sample means preserve the nominal ranking for activity and decay heat; 0/72 sample failures.
headline_results.pathway_attribution: Significant-nuclide pathway closure ~2e-6 at every step for all three cases.

machinery_changes_forced_by_flagship: DecisionRule.times_s: rank/band rules previously evaluated at every shared cooling time; an optional declared-time scope was added so rules apply only where intended. Early-time ordering genuinely differs from 100 y.

CollapsedLibrary::validate_flux: bit-exact flux comparison rejected every flux_rel_std sample (24/24 failed) because spectrum.total rescales flux_per_group at run time while remaining signature-invariant. Collapsed rates are flux-denominator-normalized, so only spectrum shape is collapse-relevant; validation now compares normalized shapes. Restores the P31 reuse intent.
conditions: This phase demonstrates the flagship investigation executed end-to-end under the declared spectrum, schedule, compositions and sealed nuclear data only. It does not constitute experimental validation.

The AI leg of W-MATCMP is not executed: P33/P34 remain blocked on the user's AI-provider credentials and independent human evaluators. The flagship's defining 'with and without AI' comparison therefore remains open.
Conclusions are material-, spectrum-, schedule- and data-specific; no claim of generality, predictive superiority, regulatory qualification or competitive position.

pathway_closure (max relative deviation over all nuclides) is unstable on numerically dead inventories (~1e-80 atoms/g); the recorded qualification criterion is closure over nuclides >=1e-9 of step-peak atoms (~2e-6). The raw field remains emitted for transparency.
Robustness covers composition and flux-normalization channels only; cross_section_mf33 covariance sampling was not enabled in this study and is carried by P30's qualified envelope.
Early-time rankings are physically flat/reversed; any consumer must respect the declared times_s scope of the decision rules.

repair_rounds.notes: First execution exposed the validate_flux shape bug (all flux samples failed); one repair round used, consistent with the one-repair-per-gate rule.
